They planned a family reunion for summer 2024 and a honeymoon in Canada in February 2024 (skiing, local food, snowy scenery; Evan wanted to try poutine).

- Had a sudden heart palpitation/health scare the week before 6 June 2023; it prompted him to eat less processed food and sugary snacks, though he loves ginger snaps. A suspicious check-up finding led to a hospital scare around mid-November 2023, but doctors said it was a misunderstanding and he was fine.
- Injured his knee: twisted it around 18 August 2023, planned PT and swam meanwhile; by 6 October he said PT helped and he was doing easy exercises. Later hurt it playing basketball with his kids the week before 6 October.
- Lost his job in October 2023 when his company downsized; job hunting was hard, but he tried to stay hopeful.
- Enjoys watercolor painting, especially landscapes and nature; began years earlier after a friend introduced/inspired him, and took watercolor classes starting around mid-August 2023. Painting relaxes him and helps express feelings. Shared paintings: cactus/desert, sunset, landscapes, figurative work. One painting was published in an exhibition; a close friend helped him get it shown.
- Got a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar as a gift from a close friend (November 2023).
- Drives a Prius, used for trips; it broke down in December 2023. He had bought it after his old Prius broke down, repaired and sold the old car (May 2023). Had a minor road accident in the Prius on a mountain drive in late December; family was okay.
- Loves nature, beaches, sunsets and travel. Grew up on a small island he calls his happy place; it remains deeply meaningful. Favorite beach sunset spot near home helps him unwind; he and Sam discussed visiting together in December 2023. Took family to Jasper via Icefields Parkway and stayed in a cozy mountain/forest cabin in May 2023; went to the Rockies in April/May, and Banff for skiing in July 2023. Likes skiing, snowboarding, ice skating. Went kayaking/camping last summer, and snowshoeing with partner in early January 2024.
- Helped lost tourists twice (one episode became an impromptu city tour, ca. late September 2023).
- Frequently loses his keys, joking it is nearly weekly; Sam suggested a GPS tracker in December 2023.

He has described health discomfort limiting movement, low confidence/motivation, and feeling weight prevents him fully living. Made meal plan and workout schedule on 9 January 2024; planned doctor appointment for balanced diet advice and low-impact exercise guidance, but had not yet seen doctor in a while. Evan suggested swimming, yoga, walking. Sam planned beach walks and hoped for positive changes.

Discussed a local lake with trails about a two-hour drive away (27 August); said a day trip was doable, but completion not confirmed. Planned hiking with Evan in October and December, not confirmed.

Sam sketches occasionally and loves journaling/creative writing as a way to understand feelings. Began enjoying morning runs by 26 December.
